title: = puts, == asks
instructions: One = puts a value in a box: guess = 7 makes guess hold 7.
Two == asks a question: guess == 7 checks if guess holds 7, and changes nothing.
if (guess = secret) doesn't ask anything. It copies the secret into guess, so the answer always looks right!
task: The guess is 4 and the secret is 7, but it says you got it. Fix it so the program prints:  Not this time!
hint:
Ask with two equals signs:

    if (guess == secret) {
